description: WithEvents declarations are valid only in class/document/form modules
Implements directives are valid only in class modules
Implemented interface must resolve to a known project/type symbol
Class must provide required prefixed member coverage for each implemented interface
Event declarations are valid only in object modules
Event declarations cannot use Optional arguments
Event declarations cannot use ParamArray arguments
RaiseEvent statements are valid only in class modules
RaiseEvent target must match a declared event in the class module
